title: 第13章 急救第14章 医馆
content_zh:
杨威将石块接过手中仔细打量，这块石头的边缘平整说明其中的记录较为完整
“徐掌柜你这宝贝从哪来的有没有详细记载？杨威问
“具体我也记不清了，这东西以前都是放在家族祠堂供奉的，若不是遭遇此番劫难也不会将其带出，怎么小友莫非看出了些什么？
徐掌柜好奇反问，这东西他们家倒不是没研究过，只是几代人也没看出是个什么玩意
“嗯，上面记录了一些修仙知识”
杨威如实回答有些心动也没过分在意
“那小友觉得能值多少？
徐掌柜接着又问
“这个要看卖给什么人，若是放在这拍卖会上，我也不好说”
杨威说的都是实话，体修之术本就并非主流
懂得妖族文字的人更是少之又少
人普遍认为妖族的东西都是糟粕，开了灵智的还能叫妖修没开的那就是畜生
它们创造的文明和人族没法相提并论，如萤火与皓月又怎么会值得高贵的人去学习
“那这该如何是好？
“要不老夫干脆卖给小友如何？如果对你有用的话，我可以给你便宜一些”
徐掌柜到底是做生意的人，他也知道这东西也就这么回事
说是传家宝他们家研究了很久也没搞出名堂，如今碰到个懂的干脆别卖了救急
“嗯，既然掌柜这么说了，那你准备卖多少钱？
杨威没有主动报价而是将定价的权利交给对方
“小友觉得五十灵石，合适不？

徐掌柜略作迟疑后说道
“没问题”
说罢杨威便掏出袋子数灵石
既没有与方讨价还价也没有多给，虽然这套功法的价值远不止于此但在一般不识货的人眼中却只会卖的比这更低
“什么？五十灵石，掌柜的你想钱想疯了吧？
一直欲言又止的翠翠忍不住破口大骂
“威哥你想清楚了，这可是一百五十两金子，一千五百两白银！
换这么一块破石头有什么用？
翠翠拉住杨威手示意这笔买卖亏大了
这么多钱都够她买三件那黑店的衣服了，若是放在红林村是他们一辈子也花不完的钱
“我自有分寸”
杨威很是平静的继续掏钱，一手交钱一手交货后便与徐掌柜告别了
这次交易可谓是各取所需，徐掌柜没钱逃难来的，还有一家子人等他养活，这五十枚灵石对于他来说就是雪中送炭自然卖得开心
收好石块后杨威便要住处研究一番，回去的路上翠翠也不说话只是生着闷气
content_en:
Yang Wei took the stone in his hand and looked at it carefully. The flat edge of the stone showed that the records in it were relatively complete.
"Shopkeeper Xu, do you have a detailed record of where this treasure came from? Yang Wei asked
"I can't remember the specifics. This thing used to be enshrined in the family ancestral hall. If it hadn't been for this disaster, it wouldn't have been taken out. Could it be that my little friend saw something?
Shopkeeper Xu curiously asked, it’s not that their family has never studied this thing, it’s just that generations of people haven’t figured out what it is.
"Well, it contains some knowledge about cultivating immortals."
Yang Wei answered truthfully and was a little moved but didn't care too much.
“How much do you think it’s worth, little friend?
Shopkeeper Xu then asked
"It depends on who it is sold to. If it is put at this auction, I can't say."
What Yang Wei said is true. The art of body cultivation is not mainstream.
There are even fewer people who understand the demon language.
People generally believe that everything from the demon clan is trash. Those who have developed spiritual wisdom can still be called demon cultivators, and those who have not developed their spiritual intelligence are just beasts.
The civilization they created cannot be compared with the human race. How can the fireflies and the bright moon be worthy of noble people to learn from?
“Then what should we do?
"How about I just sell it to my friend? If it's useful to you, I can give you a cheaper price."
Shopkeeper Xu is a businessman after all, and he also knows that this is what it is.
They say it's a family heirloom and they've been researching it for a long time but haven't made it famous yet. Now that they've met someone who understands, they might as well not sell it.
"Well, since the shopkeeper said so, how much are you going to sell it for?
Yang Wei did not take the initiative to quote but handed over the pricing rights to the other party.
"Little friend, do you think fifty spiritual stones is appropriate?
Shopkeeper Xu hesitated for a moment and then said
“No problem”
After saying that, Yang Wei took out the bag and counted the spiritual stones.
I neither bargained with Fang nor gave him more. Although the value of this set of exercises is much more than this, in the eyes of ordinary people who don't know the goods, it will only be sold for less than this.
"What? Fifty spirit stones, shopkeeper, are you crazy about money?
Cuicui, who had been hesitant to speak, couldn't help but cursed
"Brother Wei, please think clearly, this is one hundred and fifty taels of gold and one thousand five hundred taels of silver!
What's the use of replacing such a broken stone?
Cuicui took Yang Wei's hand and signaled that the deal was a big loss.
This much money is enough for her to buy three pieces of clothes from the black shop. If they were left in Honglin Village, it would be money that they would never be able to spend in their lifetime.
"I have my own sense of proportion"
Yang Wei calmly continued to pay. After handing over the money and delivering the goods, he said goodbye to Shopkeeper Xu.
This transaction can be said to be about getting what everyone needs. Shopkeeper Xu came here because he had no money to escape, and there was a family waiting for him to support. For him, these fifty spiritual stones were a timely help, and he was naturally happy to sell them.
After collecting the stones, Yang Wei went to study the place where he lived. On the way back, Cuicui didn't say anything but just sulked.
